description: This file defines the Language controller class for the OpenCart system. It manages the display and saving of language settings in the common controller area, handling language switching and updates via HTTP requests.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class managing language display and persistence in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of language selection interface, loading language data, building URLs, and returning the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving a new language selection, validating input, updating session data, and redirecting accordingly.
